score.name: Empire score
score.description: Your current score from your empire, military and lifetime yields from sources in play.

sixYields.name: Total yields
sixYields.description: The food, production, gold, science, culture and faith your empire produces per turn, added together.

scienceCulture.name: Science and culture gained
scienceCulture.description: All science and culture your empire has gained during this age.

faithGold.name: Faith and gold gained
faithGold.description: All faith and gold your empire has gained during this age, before spending.

purchases.name: Gold and faith spent on purchases
purchases.description: The gold and faith you have spent on purchases this age, less refunds and sale proceeds.

population.name: Total population
population.description: The number of citizens living in all your towns.

cityProduction.name: Highest town production
cityProduction.description: The production per turn of your most productive town.

buildings.name: Buildings finished
buildings.description: Buildings and wonders your towns have completed or purchased during this age.

improvements.name: Improved hexes
improvements.description: The number of hexes you own that currently have a functioning improvement.

luxuries.name: Different luxuries held
luxuries.description: The number of different luxuries your empire currently has access to.

routeYields.name: Trade route yields
routeYields.description: The yields your trade routes currently pay your empire each turn.

peopleYields.name: Great person yields
peopleYields.description: The yields your great people’s works and legacies currently pay your empire each turn.

armyStrength.name: Total army strength
armyStrength.description: The strength of all your military units, including ships, rank bonuses and bonuses that always apply.
